text: yo what's up, today we're cooking a dark trap beat from scratch at 140 bpm in F minor
first thing, drums — kick on the one, snare on three, hats running sixteenths
I like the velocity a little loose on the hats so it breathes
now let's add the 808 — long, distorted, following the kick, sliding up to F at the end of the loop
I'm putting some drive on it with the saturator, around sixty five percent
okay so for the mix, pull the 808 down a couple dB and pan the hats slightly right
and that's the loop — simple, dark, knocks
